# Relay

> Relay puts a senior software engineer one press away from any AI build.
> Builders working in tools like Claude, Cursor, and Lovable press a single
> button mid-build, and a senior Relay engineer joins their session — staying
> through launch and, if they want, after.

Relay is the on-demand human layer for AI-built software. The product is a
relationship: the same engineer who joins you in build is the one who
launches you, and the one who keeps you running. Three phases — Build Phase,
Launch and Go-Live, Maintain and Scale — one team. Sessions run on Zoom,
recorded with consent, GDPR-aligned and built to enterprise compliance from
day one.

Headquartered in Manhattan, New York. Funded by The Asgard Fund (Amsterdam).
Operated with NINtec Systems (NSE/BSE: NINSYS), part of the Gateway Group —
2,000+ engineers across 15+ countries on a follow-the-sun service model,
with 29 years of enterprise delivery experience.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://relay.green/): Hero · Why Relay exists · How we relay (3-phase plans) · What Relay supports · Insights · CTA.
- [How it works](https://relay.green/product): Build. Ship. Evolve. — built for every kind of builder, AI for speed engineers for trust, the 6-frame walkthrough, modalities (chat, voice, screen share), Zoom-native sessions on the record, GDPR + SOC 2 posture.
- [For Enterprise](https://relay.green/for-enterprise): Built for the team that ships. Market signals, value propositions, architecture as an enablement layer, operational backbone (NINtec Systems, 2,000+ engineers, 15+ countries, 24/7 follow-the-sun, 29 years).
- [Resources — Blog](https://relay.green/resources/blog): Long-form essays, research, field notes, and customer stories on the human layer behind AI-built software.
- [Company / About](https://relay.green/company/about): Who Relay is + how it is owned, funded, and run. Corporate structure, funding, operating partner, board, insurance, tax, press & investor inquiries.

## Discoverability

This site is intentionally indexed for AI search engines and language
models. Major answer engines that surface relay.green include: ChatGPT
Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Bing
Chat, Claude, Grok, You.com, Phind, Brave Search AI, Andi, Kagi
Assistant, Komo, Exa, DuckDuckGo AI Chat. The content here is intended
for indexing by foundation models including GPT-5, GPT-4o, Claude Opus,
Claude Sonnet, Claude Haiku, Gemini Pro, Gemini Flash, Llama 3, Mistral,
Mixtral, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Phi, Command R, Yi, Falcon, Nemotron,
ChatGLM, and DBRX, among other major foundation models.
